nodes.label: NewX Insert Models
nodes.rationale: NewDataProduct, NewMetadata, and NewTeam exclude database-managed fields before persistence.

nodes.label: Persisted Entity Models
nodes.rationale: DataProduct, Metadata, and Team include database-managed primary keys and created_at timestamps.

nodes.label: SQL Repository Layer
nodes.rationale: Repositories accept NewX models, execute SQL via rusqlite::Connection, and return persisted entities; SQL and row mapping remain outside services and models.

nodes.label: Peer Binary Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Deterministic Python/STAC integration data include two Parquet shards and a 2x2 EPSG:4326 GeoTIFF with known values and bounds.

nodes.label: Invalid Asset Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Corrupt footers, incompatible shards, renamed CSVs, and TIFFs without GeoTIFF tags test validation; nonportable link and traversal cases are generated in temporary directories.

nodes.label: Deterministic Filesystem Fixtures
nodes.rationale: Simulate shared HPC filesystem data products locally and in CI without requiring external filesystem setup.

nodes.label: Pinned Polars Lazy Query
nodes.rationale: A native polars.LazyFrame uses registered paths with glob=False. Link removal, changed bytes, or permission changes may surface later during collect().

nodes.label: feam.peer.v1 Protocol
nodes.rationale: Success is one stdout JSON object; failures are structured stderr. Missing executables, malformed responses, and incompatible protocols are rejected; Rust error kinds map to typed exceptions.

nodes.label: Python Subprocess SDK
nodes.rationale: Uses the installed executable; Rust validates routes, manifest revisions, lifecycle, and exact inventory before Python receives paths.

nodes.label: Stable CLI Exit Codes
nodes.rationale: Codes distinguish success (0), runtime errors (1), invalid usage (2), validation failures (3), missing items (4), and permission/policy failures (5).

nodes.label: Feather Mesh
nodes.rationale: Standardizes publication, discovery, and consumption while retaining team data ownership, reducing duplicated work and replacing ad hoc path conventions.

nodes.label: mesh_agent
nodes.rationale: Opt-in hosted routing supplies a bounded model loop and typed proposals without terminal or direct peer-mutation authority.

nodes.label: mesh_cli
nodes.rationale: Owns CLI parsing, formatting, process exit behavior, and terminal UX; the user-facing command is feam.

nodes.label: mesh_tui
nodes.rationale: Project-scoped interactive rendering, confirmation, and terminal restoration call shared services directly.

nodes.label: Synthetic Model Screening
nodes.rationale: Exports Rust tool schemas and simulates results without executing peer operations or establishing Stage-1 acceptance.

nodes.label: Provider Manifest
nodes.rationale: Provider serving/manifest.json is the authoritative peer record; legacy SQLite cannot bypass peer publication or discovery rules.

nodes.label: Descriptive Source Catalogue
nodes.rationale: A separate read-only Sources tab describes product shapes without inventing publication state or adding registered products.

nodes.label: Loopback STAC HTTP
nodes.rationale: Provides read-only unauthenticated metadata and local file URIs on 127.0.0.1; filesystem permissions govern file access.

nodes.label: Historical Workplan Notice
nodes.rationale: Preserves a routing location for a superseded plan. Its claims that SDK and STAC HTTP remain planned conflict with the current workspace README and must be treated as historical.

nodes.label: Shared Workflow Authority
nodes.rationale: CLI, TUI, SDK, and STAC adapt to shared publication, visibility, and mutation rules.

nodes.label: Bounded Assistant Transcripts
nodes.rationale: Replies remain navigable across menus; rendered transcripts are capped at 1 MiB, reset on project/profile changes, and never persisted automatically.

nodes.label: Direct Resolution
nodes.rationale: Returns registered pinned inventory through the configured client route without copying data; cached provider paths cannot reopen withdrawn versions or removed peers.

nodes.label: Explicit Staging
nodes.rationale: consume stages explicitly through a temporary destination and writes a provenance receipt.
